structural_guards: No new whole-file copy/materialization on ordinary bounded retrieval or per-turn operation.
No provider call under an owner mutation lock.
No unbounded queue or stale-owner retry loop.
thresholds.tighter_baseline_rule: Existing tighter, directly applicable accepted baselines take precedence; record the accepted baseline and scope.

comparison.pair_definition: One old and one new sample for the same case, frozen input, machine profile, and session; record arm order and alternate which arm runs first.

quantile_method.median: Conventional median; average the two middle observations when the count is even.

bootstrap.unit: Aligned old/new sample pairs; resample pair indexes with replacement within each of three sessions.
bootstrap.index_rng: SplitMix64-v1 with rejection sampling for unbiased bounded indexes.
bootstrap.seed: First 64 bits big-endian of SHA-256(UTF-8(policy_schema_id + NUL + case_id + NUL + metric_id + NUL + session_id)); separate stream per session.
bootstrap.latency: Compute p50 and p95 ratio per resample.
bootstrap.throughput: Compute p50 candidate/reference ratio per resample.
bootstrap.memory: Compute p50 ratio of per-sample process peak bytes; also report every sample and observed maximum.

rules.unsupported_old_capability: NOT_COMPARABLE; never treat as zero cost.
rules.no_trustworthy_reference: UNBASELINED; freeze a case-specific absolute limit and rationale before release measurement and keep the G5 item open until reviewed.
rules.incomparable_build_or_inputs: INCONCLUSIVE; rerun under comparable host and input conditions without changing limits.
rules.measurement_window_violation: INCONCLUSIVE; do not accept a run with overlapping work or forbidden machine changes.
rules.correctness: Any unexplained semantic, privacy, history, or recovery difference is FAIL regardless of speed.

comparison.near_zero_reference: Batch a repeatable operation until the total timed interval exceeds measured monotonic-clock resolution; record batch size and resolution. No ratio exemption.

short_operations.interpretation: One pair contains one old and one new sample; this conservative per-session reading meets or exceeds the stated minimum.

costly_open_or_maintenance.interpretation: One pair contains one old and one new sample; alternate which arm runs first across pairs and sessions.

sampling.cap_rule: If the 95% interval still straddles the threshold at the explicit cap, report INCONCLUSIVE; do not extend the cap or change a threshold after results.
sampling.outliers: Retain and report every sample; never silently remove or replace an outlier.
sampling.session_rule: Preserve raw samples and session IDs; never pool away session boundaries.

machine_safety.exclusive_measurement_window: Required for release measurements, not merely a separate worktree.
machine_safety.normal_editing: Allowed only when it does not create competing CPU/disk load.
machine_safety.cold_start: Fresh process only; no cold-OS-cache claim.
machine_safety.build: Release mode with locked dependencies; record compiler, optimization/features, source and binary hashes.
machine_safety.storage: Check free space before release compilation; reuse an isolated cache per incompatible runtime; serialize Cargo; do not create per-ticket target directories or delete another lane's cache.
machine_safety.mutation: Run mutations on copies and recheck source/candidate custody hashes afterward.

evidence.privacy: Report hashes, IDs, and counts; never conversation text, credentials, or raw private payloads.
